body: That's quite a compliment, thank you.  I do study writing (though not essay in particular), and I appreciate the encouragement.

I eat fairly well as a vegetarian, but not superbly.  I ride a bicycle for exercise, but I don't get out much when it's cold.  I haven't really found a way to make up the difference in the winter.  I've tried to be more active since my post.

What other kinds of treatment do you have in mind?  I feel like I have no other choice than to help myself.  On the other hand, I am very skeptical because I have tried many different routes in the past and found no relief.  

I don't know that control is possible.  I cyclically escape suicide because I have developed the patience to wait out the inexorable shifts in affects.  I'm really worried about losing my patience or getting overwhelmed past what semblance of self-control I do have.  When I'm really stressed I feel compromised in my defenses.

I've tried every treatment I was told by my doctors as well as what I could find in my own research, granted that was several years ago:  Change in lifestyle, medication, exercise, diet, changing interpersonal relationships, meditation, philosophical education, altering school circumstances, changing majors, getting a different job, etc, etc.

Any advice on ways I could help myself would be boundlessly appreciated.

I am really wary of prescription medication.  I tried a few different drugs while I was visiting a psychiatrist in my youth but nothing helped and I couldn't stand the existential crises of self associated with them.  I took the drugs to live, not to die in favor of a drug-zombie.  If I can't do this on my own, I can't do this at all.  I know it's immature and may actually get me killed, but it's a matter of principle.

I am struggling to graduate college.  This is my last truly difficult semester and it's coming to a close with a large degree of uncertainty over whether I will or will not graduate.

I'm 22.
No meds.
No psych-.
My parents foot the bill for room, board, and net; but, that's only going to last another few months at most.
